title: FacilityRegistrationBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Envelope for a batch of Facility registrations spanning one or more Sites. Each entry in batches is itself a batch of Facility records (int:Facility, formerly GridBuilding) belonging to the same Site. Each Facility is an apartment, unit, or group of apartments within the Site; it sits behind the metering and control boundary and owns or operates Assets. Maps to cim:EnergyConsumer (IEC CIM 61970-301 Wires package). State and time-series measurement fields (occupancy, operational mode, power/current/voltage/frequency readings) are out of scope for this schema and are covered by the separate FacilityState and FacilityMeasurement EWDS Topic schemas.

siteId.description: FK to the Site that all Facilities in facilityList belong to.

facilityId.description: Primary identifier of the facility or building.

ownerIds.description: FKs to the owner(s) of the facility, via Actor. Empty if the facility is owned by the public/community.

loadModelId.description: FK to the cim:EnergyConsumer load model representing this facility in the distribution network topology. Not all facilities have a formal load model (e.g. Aran Islands has incomplete network data).

name.description: Name of the building or facility.

p.description: Steady-state active power demand in W, used for network load-flow calculations. Planning value, not a real-time measurement. CIM attribute name is p (not power).

q.description: Steady-state reactive power demand in VAr. Planning value. CIM attribute name is q.

phaseConnection.description: How the load phases are connected. CIM PhaseShuntConnectionKind enum: Y, Yn, D, Ii. Distinct from phaseConfiguration on Site/UsagePoint, which describes the grid connection point rather than the load connection.

facilityType.description: The type of facility: whether it is an apartment, a unit, or a group of apartments/units. Field name and enumeration are not yet finalised in the ontology workbook; verify against upcoming ontology updates before treating as stable.

numApartmentUnits.description: The number of apartment units represented in this facility.
